Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the shallow water-table aquifer near the county seat of Keith County, Nebraska, is the North Platte River alluvial aquifer instead of the Ogallala Aquifer. This error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the information from the USGS sources, which described the Ogallala Aquifer as a shallow water-table aquifer. While the Ogallala Aquifer may have sections that are semi-confined, it is still widely recognized as the shallow water-table aquifer in this area. The Planner's focus on localized geological features led to an overly narrow interpretation, deviating from the broader and more widely accepted identification of the aquifer.
